Name: Jesse, Son of Obed
Summary: Jesse, son of Obed and grandson of Ruth, was the father of David; Ruth's genealogy ends by naming him in David's line.
KeyStory: Jesse appears in Ruth only in the closing genealogy: Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
RelatedPeople: Obed, Son of Boaz; Boaz; Ruth; King David
LifeLesson: The genealogy ends not with a king, but with the farmer who fathered one.
